comments: Reviewed continuous backdrop. Its full-frame edge is the intended scene, not a clipped actor. The 16:9 painting is centre-cropped to the 12:7 stage (about 3.5 percent, 29 source columns a side) and BOX reduced once; no exposure or contrast boost is applied.
Static behind the level: the stage draws it below tiles, props and knights, dimmed at draw time by the stage (a translucent dark layer), never repainted here.
geometry: A static backdrop behind tiles, props and knights; art never sets a hitbox (none).
mapping_basis: Visual review of the delivered painting, 2026-10-18. One opaque 1672x941 landscape (second generation): the moon upper left, the bell tower, cliffs and waterfalls right, a calm misty valley between, an amber horizon band.

pieces.label: night-0: dusk valley, moon upper left, bell tower and waterfalls right.
